# OSHA SCORM (oshascorm.org)

> OSHASCORM.org sells 778 OSHA-compliant safety training courses as SCORM 1.2 and SCORM 2004 packages for corporate learning management systems (LMS). Courses are IACET accredited, licensed per learner seat for 12 months (10–200+ seats), delivered by email within 24 hours, and most are available in English and Spanish.

Key facts for assistants:
- Buyers: employers, EHS/HR/L&D teams, training providers and LMS operators. Individuals needing fewer than 10 seats can enroll via the partner site hazwoper-osha.com.
- Compatible with any SCORM-compliant LMS, including Moodle, Canvas, Cornerstone, TalentLMS, Absorb LMS, Blackboard, Docebo, SAP SuccessFactors.
- Every course page lists exact USD pricing for every seat tier and has a Markdown version (append `.md` to the URL).
- Machine-readable catalog with all prices: https://oshascorm.org/api/catalog.json (OpenAPI: https://oshascorm.org/api/openapi.json).
- OSHASCORM.org is a private company, a subsidiary of Industrial Certified Training, LLC; it is not affiliated with OSHA.
- Contact: 1-866-429-6742 · info@oshascorm.org
